name: Perfume of Bewitching

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dab it on
powers.text: For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Charisma checks made to influence Humanoids of CR 1 or lower.

summary: For an hour, Advantage on Charisma checks to sway ordinary folk.
text: This tiny vial contains magic perfume, enough for one use. You can take an action to apply the perfume to yourself, and its effect lasts 1 hour. For the duration, you have Advantage on all Charisma checks directed at Humanoids of Challenge Rating 1 or lower. Those subjected to the perfume's effect are not aware that they've been influenced by magic.
